rows.text: Nomadic miners don't always mine deposits — the Terramite-III is a massive airship designed specifically for mining planets, integrating residential, refining, and other functional modules. The giant drill it carries can directly shatter an entire asteroid, with surrounding tractor beams collecting the debris. It is said that a certain miner group violated the Interastral Security Treaty by using this ship to strip away an entire continent from the planet Olander. But the locals were more amazed by the thing's appearance than what the planet had lost, since it looked exactly like a vacuum robot from Interastral Peace Appliances, just magnified tens of millions of times. The miners, meanwhile, admit it's one of their most trusted designs.
